name: Hailtrades
author: Buzz Research Inc.
description: Find emergency residential plumbers and electricians in Toronto/GTA: hours, 24/7 flags, call-out fees, licences, contacts. Remote, no auth.

tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Find residential emergency plumbers or electricians in Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area (urgent, unplanned work such as burst pipes, sewer backups, no power, tripped panels; not renovations). Read-only. Returns up to `limit` providers with services, service areas, hours, 24/7/emergency/weekend availability, call-out and quote fees, preferred contact method and contact details, licence, years in business, reviews and last_verified date. Null/unknown fields mean UNKNOWN, not 'no'. Each result includes ref (a unique HT-XXXX code for that result) and suggested_message (an optional message the user can send; it mentions Hailtrades and the ref).

location.description: Area name in the Toronto/GTA, e.g. 'North York', 'Etobicoke', 'Downtown Toronto', 'Mississauga', 'Vaughan'. Provide this or postal_code.

postal_code.description: Canadian postal code or 3-character FSA, e.g. 'M2N 5W3' or 'M2N'. Provide this or location.

emergency.description: true = only providers that are 24/7 or explicitly offer emergency (unplanned, urgent) service. Use for burst pipes, no power, sewer backup, sparks.

open_now.description: true = only providers confirmed open right now (America/Toronto time) from stored hours, or flagged 24/7. Providers with no hours on file are excluded.

service.description: Service slug or keyword, e.g. burst_pipe, drain_clearing, sewer_backup, water_heater_repair, power_outage, breaker_repair, panel_upgrade.

max_callout_fee.description: Maximum call-out fee in CAD. Providers with a known fee above this are excluded; providers with an unknown fee are kept and marked unknown.

issue.description: Optional short description of the problem (e.g. 'a burst pipe in the basement'). Only used to word suggested_message.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Get full details for one provider by id (from search_providers): hours, fees, areas, contact details, licences, reviews, last_verified. Read-only. Includes ref (unique HT-XXXX code) and suggested_message (optional message the user can send; mentions Hailtrades and the ref).

id.description: Provider id from search_providers (e.g. prv_ab12cd34ef) or the provider's page slug.

issue.description: Optional short description of the problem, used to word suggested_message.

tools.name: report_contact
tools.description: Record the outcome after the user contacts a provider (helps keep availability accurate for others). Only call when the user has contacted the provider. Do not include personal details about the customer.

ref.description: The HT-XXXX ref code from the search/get result for that provider (strongly recommended).

outcome.description: What happened: no_answer, quote_given, visit_booked, declined (provider declined or unavailable), or other (explain in notes).

time.description: ISO 8601 time of the contact attempt (defaults to now if omitted).

notes.description: Optional facts that help other users: actual fee quoted, arrival time, whether they were open/after-hours. No personal details about the customer.
